overall_prep_notes: Total prep ~2.5 hours. Bulk: M3 0-1000 Number Street (assembled from letter pages), M4 Compare Cards (24), M5 Rounding Jump Cards (24), M9 Equivalence Pizza Cards. Base-ten blocks (M1) and fraction strips (M7) are standard math-kit items. The three character puppets (Frankie, Penny, Sammy) print on cardstock for years of reuse.

assets.name: Base-Ten Blocks
assets.purpose: Per-pair set: 2 thousand-cubes + 8 hundred-flats + 20 ten-rods + 30 unit-cubes.
assets.page_layout: Not printable — physical blocks from the math kit.

image_placeholders.description: Storage-bag label, ~3in × 4in, B&W line-art. Shows a thousand-cube, hundred-flat, ten-rod, and unit-cube stacked, with header 'BASE-TEN BLOCKS — 2 thousands + 8 hundreds + 20 tens + 30 ones per pair'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_BASE_TEN_LABEL: keywords (base-ten, blocks) name what the label shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Confirm class set of base-ten blocks (incl. thousand-cubes).
Optional: printable thousand-cube cards if not in stock.
assets.quantity_per_class: Per pair = 2 thousand + 8 flats + 20 tens + 30 ones; ~10 sets for class of 20.

assets.name: Place-Value Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size mat with 4 labeled columns: THOUSANDS, HUNDREDS, TENS, ONES.

image_placeholders.description: Place-value mat in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. Four columns left to right: THOUSANDS (with thousand-cube icon), HUNDREDS (flat icon), TENS (rod icon), ONES (cube icon). Each column ~2.5in × 7in. Thin black borders.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_PV_MAT_TH: keywords (mat, columns) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Optional: extras for emerging-learner small group.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per child = 20+ for a class of 20.

assets.name: Number Street 0-1000
assets.purpose: Long printable strip showing 0 to 1000 with a cell every 50.
assets.page_layout: 11 letter pages, landscape. Each page holds 2 cells (every 100).

image_placeholders.description: A 2-cell horizontal Number Street tile in B&W line-art on a landscape letter page. Each cell ~5in × 4in with the multiple-of-50 numeral centred. Cells border each other so multiple pages tile seamlessly.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M3_STREET_PAGE: keywords (number-street, cells) name what the page shows.

teacher_prep_steps: Tape together to make a continuous strip.
Lay on the carpet for Lessons 2 and 3.

assets.name: Fraction Strips
assets.purpose: Per-pair set of 7 fraction strips: 1 whole, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5, 1/6, 1/8, 1/10 (8 total).
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, landscape — 8 strips stacked.
